text.스펙 작업을 팀 구성으로 실행하고 결과를 작업 표시와 추적 표에 반영한다: Runs spec tasks with teams and reflects the results in task status and the trace table
text.스펙 작업을 팀 구성 실행으로 돌리는 연동의 이름·결과 표·한도(설치자: Name, result table and limits of the integration that runs spec tasks as team runs (server administrator values).
text.작업 동작 주소와 실행 메뉴 항목이 쓰는 연동 이름입니다. 바꾸면 화면이: Integration name used by task action addresses and run menu items. Changing it also changes the action names the screen remembers.
Change this only if the name clashes with another task integration plugin.
text.검증 목적 실행의 결과를 추적 표에 넣는 검증 출처의 이름입니다. 스펙: Name of the verification source that puts the results of verification runs into the trace table. Turn it on or off by this name in the verification source list of the spec settings.
Change this only if the name clashes with another verification source plugin.
text.작업에서 시작한 실행의 시작 경로(Run origin)로 남길 이름입니다: Name recorded as the run origin of runs started from a task.
Change this when you want task runs labeled differently in the run list.
text.실행 상태(예: completed)를 스펙 규칙이 쓰는 결과 이름(예:: Maps run statuses (for example completed) to the result names spec rules use (for example succeeded). Statuses not in the table keep their own name.
Change this when you want spec rules to use different result names.
text.이 실행 이벤트가 오면 실행 프로필 status_on대로 작업 상태를 바: When these run events arrive, the task status changes as the run profile's status_on says. Leave empty to never change the status (the run chip still shows).
Remove the start event if you want the status to change only when the run ends.
text.작업 실행 칩·추적 표를 만들 때 스펙 하나에서 읽는 최근 실행 수의 상: Upper limit on recent runs read per spec to build task run chips and the trace table. Above it, older runs don't show.
Lower this when the screen is slow for specs with a great many runs.
Number of runs per page when reading run history.
You usually don't need to change this.
text.자동 진행이 이 결과 이름으로 끝난 실행을 실패로 셉니다. 같은 작업이: Auto-advance counts runs that end with these result names as failures. If the same task fails as many times in a row as the spec rule's failure limit, the task is skipped.
Add cancelled if you want canceled runs counted as failures too.
text.이 결과 이름으로 끝난 작업은 실패로 세지 않고 다시 시작합니다(예: 끊: Tasks that end with these result names restart without counting as failures (for example interrupted runs). Tasks that end with other results don't restart until the task line changes.
Leave empty if you don't want interrupted runs restarted automatically.
